poc_details: POC goal: meet p95 <= 60ms chat (single-turn) and p95 <= 120ms rerank while reducing per-token cost by >=30% vs baseline.
Test matrix: models (llama-2-13b, llama-2-70b-quant, mistral-small), quant modes (fp16, int8, 4-bit), batch sizes (1,4,8,16), cache TTL (0s, 30s, 5m).
Instrumentation: token-level latency tracing, cache hit/miss logs, cost-per-1000-tokens estimate, end-to-end tail latency measurement (client -> redis cache -> runtime).
Acceptance: quality regression tolerance <=2% on customer eval set; cost target met; operational runbook for fallback + autoscale validated.
perf_findings_summary: Early runs: continuous batching improved throughput but increased p95 — tradeoff region identified around batch size 4 for chat to keep latency tight.
Prefix caching: 40% latency reduction on chat where prompts share common preamble; cache invalidation policy requested (per-session TTL).
Quantization: int8 gave ~2.5x throughput improvement on same GPU with <1.5% delta on rerank tests; 4-bit showed more variability — need more eval across edge cases.
Recommendation: Dedicated pools + Optimize (suggested batch/caching profiles) + canary rollout with fallback model variant.
